d: James Harden put on a HISTORIC performance against the Indiana Pacers, exploding for 51 PTS, 6 REB, 6 AST and 7 3PM! At 37 years old, Harden became one of just four players in NBA history aged 37 or older to record at least 50 points, 5 rebounds and 5 assists in a single game. He also passed Kobe Bryant for the third-most 50-point games in NBA history, tied Michael Jordan for the all-time lead in 40-point, 5-assist games, and recorded his highest-scoring half of the season.
